descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Hello, let’s meet! 
 Xebia is a global AI-first, digital transformation, and engineering partner. With over 25 years of experience and a team of 5,000 professionals across 16 countries, we help organizations design and build scalable products, platforms, and data-driven solutions. 
 We specialize in Artificial Intelligence, Data and Cloud, Intelligent Automation, and Digital Products, combining deep technical expertise with a strong focus on engineering excellence and a people-first culture. 
 In the CEE region, we’re a team of nearly 1,000 experts delivering modern applications, data platforms, and AI solutions for clients such as Millennium, ING, Play, Edenred, Arabian Drilling, FedEx, Leroy Merlin, Truecaller, Volotea, Schmitz Cargobull, and many, many more.
 You will be: 
managing and improving deployment and release processes across development, lab, and production environments,
designing, maintaining, and improving reliable infrastructure and delivery solutions,
supporting teams in adopting effective DevOps practices and ways of working,
contributing to infrastructure modernization with a focus on performance, reliability, and cost efficiency,
supporting development and support teams in resolving critical production issues,
coordinating product and operating system updates across different environments,
managing Infrastructure as Code and ensuring infrastructure follows agreed standards and best practices,
contributing to planning, release management, documentation, and continuous improvement activities.
 Your profile: 
hands-on experience as a DevOps Engineer or in a similar role,
practical experience using AI-powered assistants (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to improve productivity, quality, or decision-making in software delivery,
practical experience with Ansible, Terraform, Bash, Git, and CI/CD pipelines,
hands-on experience with Docker and Docker Swarm, preferably in on-premises environments,
good knowledge of core AWS services, including EC2, CloudFormation, VPC, Subnets, AMIs, ALBs, S3, and ECR,
understand Infrastructure as Code and infrastructure automation best practices,
experience working with both cloud and on-premises, air-gapped environments,
a good understanding of JSON,
experience creating, maintaining, and troubleshooting Azure Pipelines,
familiarity with monitoring and observability solutions, with an appreciation of ELK Stack and Grafana,
experience with firewall management, preferably FortiGate,
understand Agile development processes and are comfortable participating in Agile ceremonies,
strong DevOps mindset and understand the importance of collaboration across development, support, and infrastructure teams,
strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills and can approach complex technical issues independently,
can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders,
comfortable working in an environment where issues often require investigation, creativity, and finding solutions beyond standard approaches,
good documentation skills and understand the importance of keeping technical documentation accurate and up to date,
good English communication skills (at least B2 level).
 Work from the European Union region and a work permit are required. 
 Recruitment Process: 
 CV review – HR call – Interview – Client Interview – Decision
